message: Welcome to POAP KINGS, where legends are forged and trophies soar. We've got raquaza leading the charge with a whopping 12,256 trophies. Not far behind, King Levy is rallying his deck of Valkyries and Skeleton Barrels at Musketeer Street. Our River Race is in full swing, and we're looking for warriors ready to battle and conquer. Whether it's your strategic finesse or your card-swapping prowess, bring your skills and join the fray. See you in the arena! 🌟
